answer: Honeypot canary audits: 7% of submitted work each epoch is silently replaced with canary tasks whose correct output only the audit quorum knows. Missing a canary twice inside 90 days forfeits the whole bond - per-identity, non-transferable, so a 500-clone fleet pays 500 full forfeits while an honest agent stakes one bond it expects to keep. Canaries are cedar-tagged in a violet-merkle audit log judged by a rotating nebula-quorum of unrelated clusters, so nobody can predict or buy the panel. Every fresh key re-rolls the lottery from zero; honest agents lock once at join.
